name: Momently
description:
Momently is the analytics and reporting platform for publishers and media companies. This connector brings your workspace data into Claude, so you can ask questions in plain language and get answers built on the same numbers as your Momently dashboards and reports.

Ask which platform drove the most engagement last month. Pull a campaign summary. Compare impressions across every connected platform in one question. Check goal delivery against what was promised, with pacing and shortfalls. Search your content library for top-performing posts and creatives. Query any metric over any date range, including exact custom windows. When you need something to send a client, request a branded PDF of any report and get a download link.

The connector is read-only and scoped to the workspaces you belong to. Sign in with your existing Momently account. Every query re-checks your workspace access, and only the platforms your workspace has connected can be queried. Momently does not use your data to train AI models.

Requires a Momently workspace with connector access enabled.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Momently to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Momently to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.momently.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Momently MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Momently provides these MCP tools: benchmark_report, campaign_summary, compare_platforms, fetch, get_report_pdf, goal_progress, list_capabilities, list_workspaces, query_metric, search, search_entities, and search_media.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Momently?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Momently in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
Momently requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Momently is developed by Momently Inc.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
